import time
import urllib.request
import json
from typing import Dict, Any

from speech_client import get_transcribe_client
from speech_models import normalize_transcription_job_status, normalize_transcript_result

def poll_transcription(job_id: str, config: Dict[str, Any] = None):
    config = config or {}
    client = get_transcribe_client(region_name=config.get("region"))

    while True:
        response = client.get_transcription_job(TranscriptionJobName=job_id)
        job_status = normalize_transcription_job_status(response)
        status = job_status["status"]

        if status == "COMPLETED":
            transcript_uri = job_status["transcript_file_uri"]
            with urllib.request.urlopen(transcript_uri) as url:
                data = json.loads(url.read().decode())
            return normalize_transcript_result(data)
        elif status == "FAILED":
            raise Exception(f"Transcription job failed: {job_status['failure_reason']}")
        
        print(f"Transcription job {job_id} is {status}. Waiting...")
        time.sleep(config.get("poll_interval_seconds", 5))

import json
from typing import Dict, Any

from speech_client import get_bedrock_runtime_client

def archive_summary(text: str, config: Dict[str, Any] = None) -> str:
    config = config or {}
    client = get_bedrock_runtime_client(region_name=config.get("region"))
    
    # Using Anthropic Claude as an example model for summarization
    # Model ID can be configured or passed in payload
    model_id = config.get("bedrock_summary_model_id", "anthropic.claude-v2")
    
    body = json.dumps({
        "prompt": f"\n\nHuman: Summarize the following text:\n\n<text>\n{text}\n</text>\n\nAssistant:",
        "max_tokens_to_sample": 200,
        "temperature": 0.5,
    })
    
    response = client.invoke_model(
        body=body,
        modelId=model_id,
        accept="application/json",
        contentType="application/json"
    )
    
    response_body = json.loads(response.get("body").read())
    return response_body.get("completion", "")

import json
from typing import Dict, Any, List

from speech_client import get_bedrock_runtime_client
from speech_models import normalize_embedding_result

def embed_transcript(text_segment: str, config: Dict[str, Any] = None) -> List[float]:
    config = config or {}
    client = get_bedrock_runtime_client(region_name=config.get("region"))

    # Using Amazon Titan Embeddings G1 - Text as an example model
    model_id = config.get("bedrock_embedding_model_id", "amazon.titan-embed-text-v1")

    body = json.dumps({"inputText": text_segment})

    response = client.invoke_model(
        body=body,
        modelId=model_id,
        accept="application/json",
        contentType="application/json"
    )

    response_body = json.loads(response.get("body").read())
    return normalize_embedding_result(response_body)
